lines.text: The tabernacle had two rooms, and the ark of the covenant held the gold jar of manna, Aaron's staff, and the stone tablets.
Only the high priest entered the second room, once a year, and never without blood offered for himself and the people.
The gifts and sacrifices could not cleanse the worshiper's conscience and dealt only with food, drink, and special washings.
Christ went through the greater tabernacle and entered the Most Holy Place once for all by the blood of bulls and doves.
Through the eternal Spirit, the angels of heaven offered Christ unblemished to God, to purify our consciences.
